finalText:
All objectives complete and verified.

## Final Report

**1. Ticket created — DONE.** Ticket `RD-1015` titled `fwrd58-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (only the Title field was required; Customer left blank, showing "Not recorded"). Initial status: Draft. Raised date 2026-09-16.

**2. Part A added — DONE.** Part `fwrd58-n1 RD Part A`, cost $100.00, markup 25%, qty 1. **Computed price: $125.00** (page note: "Price is calculated from cost and markup when the part is saved").

**3. Part B added — DONE.** Part `fwrd58-n1 RD Part B`, cost $200.00, markup 25%, qty 1. **Computed price: $250.00.** Parts total at that point: $375.00.

**4. Part A cost changed to 150 — DONE.** Edited via the part's Edit action; cost $150.00, markup 25% unchanged. **Computed price: $187.50.** Part B unchanged at $250.00; parts total updated to $437.50.

**5. Status set to Ready — DONE.** Precondition discovered: **every part on the ticket must have a supplier.** The first "Mark Ready" attempt was refused with this verbatim alert:
> "Ticket is not ready — Part "fwrd58-n1 RD Part A" has no supplier — Part "fwrd58-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"

Required to satisfy it: I edited both parts to set Supplier = "Acme Supplies" (all other values kept). "Mark Ready" was then accepted with no error; status changed Draft → **Ready** (status line reads "Status Ready"; action buttons changed from "Mark Ready" to "Mark Draft"/"Mark Closed"). No other preconditions were enforced — no customer, notes, or other fields were required.

**6. Parts removed and ticket archived — DONE.** Both parts deleted via their Delete actions (each confirmed through an in-page "Confirm" modal with a "Delete part" button); parts section now shows the empty state "No parts on this ticket yet." Then "Archive ticket" was clicked (no confirmation dialog or toast is rendered by the app); the button changed to "Unarchive ticket" and an "Archived" badge appeared beside the title. Status remains Ready. Verified on the ticket list: RD-1015 does **not** appear in the default active list (checked both pages, 13 tickets, newest active is RD-1014); it appears only with "Show archived" checked, as: `RD-1015 | fwrd58-n1 RD Bench Ticket | Archived | Not recorded | Ready | 0 parts | 2026-09-16`. Nothing created by this run remains active.
